answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. By the ripple of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the meadow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the echo of the next round. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
